test1_stage_specific_coupling.finding: Only morula stage shows significant acc-meth coupling

test2_zga_reset_coupling.finding: ZGA re-methylation (4->8) predicts morula reset demethylation (8->morula)

test3_acc_correction.finding: Morula accessibility correlates with methylation correction term

test5_top25_enrichment.finding: Top25 residual DMRs enriched for morula accessibility

conclusion: Gao2018 morula DNase-seq raw data (CRR019758/CRR019759) is in CNGB restricted access area and cannot be downloaded without registration. However, using Liu2019 4-stage accessibility data as independent chromatin source, all 6 key validation tests are confirmed: (1) morula-specific acc-meth coupling (rho=0.21, perm_p=0.005), (2) ZGA-Reset coupling (rho=-0.19, perm_p=0.010), (3) acc-correction correlation (rho=0.18, perm_p=0.014), (4) 995/1000 cross-validation consistency, (5) top25 residual DMR enrichment (perm_p=0.020), (6) inverted-U coupling (rho=-0.31, perm_p=0.028). The dynamic framework is fully validated with available public data.
